title: Nasruddin and the Goose (The One-Legged Marvel)
summary: Nasruddin roasted a fat goose as a present for Timur. On the road, growing famished, he ate one of the drumsticks....
full_text:
Nasruddin roasted a fat goose as a present for Timur. On the road, growing famished, he ate one of the drumsticks.

When Timur saw the bird on the golden platter, he demanded angrily: "Where is the other leg of this goose?"

Nasruddin pointed out the window to a flock of geese resting near the pond, each standing asleep on a single leg: "Sire, all the geese in this province have only one leg!"

Timur clapped his hands loudly: "Shoo! Shoo!"

The geese startled, put down their other legs, and ran across the grass.

Timur glared at Nasruddin: "Look, fool! They have two legs!"

"Ah, Sire!" replied Nasruddin with deep bow. "If you clapped your hands at a man as loudly as you did at those birds, he would run away on four legs!" Timur laughed and rewarded him.
moral: Quick wit disarms tyrannical wrath with laughter.
